dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Ah, I was referring to a distant cousin of mine. Surname's Shikanoin, and the name's Heizou.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: He doesn't like to abide by the rules and always gets himself in trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: I figured he'd grow out of his rebellious phase... I didn't expect him to become a detective. Now I can't even find out where he is.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: As his elder cousin, I just want to take good care of him. But to do that, I need to find him first...
